text: The purpose of this report is to provide the following information: 1. Performance of the Funds for the six month period ending June 30, 2025 2. General Market Update and Benchmark Performance 3. Compliance to the Council adopted City of Toronto Investment Policy The General Group of Funds (General Fund) hold the working capital and amounts designated for the City's reserves and reserve funds. The General Fund is comprised of two pools of investments: (a) the Short Term Fund (liquidity funds managed internally), and (b) the Long Term Fund (funds not immediately required managed by the Toronto Investment Board). The General Fund had a book return of 1.7 per cent and generated $179.0 million for the six months ending June 30, 2025.
